entities.summary: Alexander Angel Nelcha Dubard is a former professional Venezuelan basketball player. Nelcha played professionally in France with JDA Dijon and Hyères-Toulon Var Basket, as well as in Italy with Mabo Pistoia and in Spain with CB Murcia. He played with the Venezuela national basketball team at the 1990 FIBA World Championship and 1992 Summer Olympics.
